The licensed run is .text 0x02115ee0..0x0211c600 (97 functions): tu_map's 93-function unit plus the four registry factories that follow it (daTrsIcon_c_classInit, daTBasket_c_classInit, daTrs_c_classInit_BOSS_TERESA, daTrs_c_classInit_TERESA). The next TU starts with daTrsTrap_c's D1 at 0x0211c600.
Each destructor is declared in its class header and defined once, out of line, first in the file. Under #pragma defer_codegen off that emits D1 then D0 in ROM order, plus a homeless D2.
The factories are `return new X()`. This TU emits the vtables, so the vptr store is the emitting-TU spelling; objisolate and reloc_audit accept it as-is.
